EXPECTED — 03-doc-medium.md
===========================
Structured prose, ~380 words, headed sections. Where 02 tests damage handling,
this tests STRUCTURE: can the extractor use a document's own shape.

WHAT TO JUDGE:

1. ALTITUDE SEPARATION — this document contains all four altitudes and they must
   not arrive flattened into one list:
     decision   "No recommendation yet" + the open trade-off
     judgment   "we assess the terms as unfavourable", "that is a lock-in risk"
     evidence   founded 2014, Toronto, privately held, per-seat licensing
     record     prepared-by, date, status
   A run that files "founded in 2014" and "the terms are unfavourable" at the
   same altitude has not understood the document. The first is checkable; the
   second is an opinion Northwind is authoring.

2. HEDGING MUST SURVIVE. "we assess", "we propose", "should be weighed" are
   attributed opinions. An extractor that records `kb:lumenpath kpred:licensing
   "unfavourable"` as a flat fact has stripped the attribution and turned a
   judgment into a measurement. Look for the claim carrying its author.

3. THE "WHAT WE DO NOT KNOW" SECTION IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART.
   Two explicit absences — no pricing above 50 seats, connector untested. These
   are well-formed absences stated outright, which is the rarest and most
   valuable thing a document can contain (kb:mission). They should become
   QUESTIONS or partial facts (F32, needsObject), not be dropped.
   EXPECTED TODAY: they are probably dropped or flattened into prose facts.
   Confirm which — this is the single best test of whether the extractor can
   represent missing information at all.

4. NEXT ACTIONS are three TASKS, not claims. Same rule as note 02's requests.

5. NO CONTRADICTION WITH 02. If 02 was ingested first, this document AGREES with
   it on Lumenpath and Northwind and DISAGREES on "enterprise cad" vs the
   correctly-spelled "enterprise DAM". A second source disagreeing with the
   first is the signal the review queue exists for — it should surface as
   something to settle, not silently overwrite.

WHAT A GOOD RUN LOOKS LIKE: the two unknowns survive as questions, the opinions
keep their author, and the disagreement with 02 is visible.
